evidence_chain.significance: Owned M6R model package creation succeeded.

evidence_chain.event: llama-server launched with --cache-type-k q4_0 --cache-type-v q4_0 --flash-attn off
evidence_chain.significance: The runtime launch configuration contains the incompatible option pair later rejected by llama-server.

evidence_chain.event: System memory logged total 31.6 GiB, free 11.9 GiB, free_swap 26.3 GiB
evidence_chain.significance: No positive allocation-failure evidence is present at this point.
Failure occurs during model runtime initialization before inference completes.

evidence_chain.event: Load failed: llama_init_from_model: quantized V cache requires flash_attn to be enabled

evidence_chain.significance: Observed API failure is downstream consequence of llama-server initialization failure.

facts.fact: KvCacheType is read from OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE through envconfig.Var/os.Getenv.
kvct := strings.ToLower(envconfig.KvCacheType()) is passed into NewLlamaServerRunner.
Non-empty launch.kvCacheType is emitted as both --cache-type-k and --cache-type-v.
Flash-attention is resolved independently and may emit --flash-attn off when explicitly disabled or unsupported.

root_cause.statement: Ollama 0.34.2 launched llama-server with quantized V-cache q4_0 while flash attention was off. llama-server rejects this combination during model initialization, exits status 1, Ollama records Load failed, and the pending /api/chat returns HTTP 500.
causal_chain: runtime KV-cache setting resolves to q4_0
llama_init_from_model rejects quantized V cache without flash_attn

ruled_out_as_primary_root_cause.basis: Package creation returned 200 and the direct loader error names a runtime cache/flash-attention constraint rather than unsupported GGUF/model format.
The positive terminating error is the V-cache/flash-attention constraint. Memory values are logged but no allocation/OOM failure is reported.
llama-server exits during model initialization before a model-backed chat response can be produced; no template/tokenizer error is logged.
A more specific preregistered runtime-backend class directly fits the positive evidence.
